purpose: Lossless pure-Debug SHA-NI lane codegen repair. Known vectors, independent wire parity, one fixed offline timing batch, then one unprofiled actual Debug original-long capture only if gates pass.

parameters.REPO: Exact clean frozen source plus fixed miniaudio/Ogg/Opus pins
parameters.OUTPUT: New guard output directory outside source
parameters.ELF: Unique actual Debug semantic_live_process_test produced by this frozen build, pin full SHA256 and size before native invocation
parameters.TAPE_DIRECTORY: Exclusively created new absolute non-symlink empty directory outside source

sequence.expected: Generate only sixteen original authored input WAVs from existing fixed generator; verify every existing SHA, never overwrite mismatch.

Known vectors, scalar comptime fallback, differential boundaries/unaligned/splits/copies/peek, independent original-std wire fixture and corruption rejection; existing short-write/error/codec tests; process self-tests and production compile. Native skips. All compilation remains Debug.
Exactly one actual recording attempt; preserve success or failure, no timing reroll. Full native cleanup and diagnostic integrity are inspected separately from exit status.

preconditions: Independent static code, excerpt/license and original-std wire fixture review passed before publication. New source and plan must be stored/read back before build; static review is not runtime proof.

Native only after focused success and separately saved result, matching Debug modes and eligible SHA-NI flags, matching offline digests, and candidate wall time <= 0.8 times baseline in the one fixed 1 MiB batch. This conservative decision gate is not a statistical or universal speed claim. If absent or unmet, stop dependent native rather than retry. Same frozen tree and pinned ELF; profile environment unset; no hooks/delays/injection/safety/hardware modes.
Create empty tape directory before invocation; verify unique ELF, dependencies, fixture hashes and source guard. Missing prerequisite is setup failure, never an actual capture attempt.
Fixed 4 MiB and 16384-descriptor lanes, original long >=32768 submitted frames, strict wire4 and finite max_generated_frames/file limits remain unchanged.
measurement_contract: One fixed offline 1 MiB standard-then-candidate batch; allocation, data preparation and printing outside timing, digests consumed and compared. No warmup, retries or best-of-N. Wall times include scheduling and order/cache effects; not CPU measurements.

SHA-NI was already eligible; this changes only equivalent second-round input lane selection. Every SHA round, safety check, integrity pass and byte boundary remains. No ReleaseSafe module or build override.

Native production-path qualification intentionally leaves collector profiling disabled; retain original instrumented failure as distinct evidence, never claim controlled collector speed ratio across different runs.

Actual whole-process duration is not collector or executable-hash time. Read actual sealed/admission/frame/command/cleanup outputs separately from exit code; no sealed/admitted history means no fresh replay.

bounds.termination: Runner SIGTERM owned process group, up to10 seconds then SIGKILL; timeout never implies clean Host teardown.

outcome: Store source and sanitized separate results on existing project branches; no raw/tape/ELF/local paths. Preserve all prior failed evidence. On a sealed strictly admitted actual long tape, freeze same-ELF fresh and wrong-launch/PCM-reference negative plans using new identities. No Windows/main/API expansion.
static_review: Independent normalized byte audit exactly matches Zig0.16 SHA256 excerpt after reversing one approved expression; MIT/source fingerprints retained.
Wire fixture uses literal wire4 fields and unchanged std SHA, not candidate Encoder/Writer; exact stream bytes and per-record corruption rejection checked.
No build mode, runtime safety, producer, queue capacity, ordering, sink or error behavior changed; format and two executable identity hash initializations use the helper.
zig fmt check differs only at the inherited final extra blank line, deliberately preserved for exact excerpt byte audit. Other changed Zig files format clean; diff whitespace check passed.

Prior attempt failed compilation before any tests because shuffle mask inferred tuple. Independent local Zig0.16 API review confirmed explicit [4]i32 mask; only helper and matching documentation changed, same lanes and all qualification bounds. Original failure preserved.
